meta.title: Crossed-out eye marks a stage not yet reviewed
gaps: Directly inspect or assert the crossed-out eye icon next to the Technical Stage tab.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly inspect or assert the crossed-out eye icon next to the Technical Stage tab.

steps.note: Provide the mandatory project title so the create flow is valid.
Create a project containing a Technical Stage and an RFQ stage.
Open the non-technical stage so the Technical Stage remains unreviewed.
Verify the Technical Stage exposes the product's not-reviewed indicator before it is opened.
Open the Technical Stage to review it.
Verify the not-reviewed indicator clears after the Technical Stage is opened.
